vulnerability.name: Access control mis-configurations suid python3 root
vulnerability.author: SecGen
vulnerability.description: The python3 interpreter is set SUID root, so any local user can run Python code as root. python3 -c 'import os; os.execl("/bin/sh", "sh", "-p")'
vulnerability.hint: An interpreter with the SUID bit set
vulnerability.solution: python3 is SUID root: run it with os.execl and sh -p to keep the effective root UID (GTFOBins python, SUID)

CyBOK.keyword: Vulnerabilities and attacks on access control misconfigurations
